metadata.coordinate_system: local meters, x=east, z=north (D4 anchor; src/geo/epsg5186.mjs)
metadata.description: walkable polygons for the separation trace: sidewalk (NGII A003 strips), crossing (CW polygons, painted zebras, estimated kerb approaches), crossing_estimated (estimated unmarked crossings, 추정), walkway_estimated (estimated walkway strips, 추정), plaza (OSM plazas, rims and building aprons; aprons estimated)

properties.source_ref: paving: E8 front courtyard: grey pavers with staggered blue-grey square tiles and terracotta centres (VR scene_e8 f cols 300-1750 of 2048; outline traced on the NGII 2025 sheet between the hedge beds and the parking bays; pattern pitch from the photo's dark squares; estimate)

paving: E8 entrance forecourt: plain grey pavers of the walk and steps between the hedge beds and the porch, and under the raised porch (the passage of the LOD4 form) (VR scene_e8 f cols 850-1250 of 2048; outline traced on the NGII 2025 sheet; estimate)

paving: VR plaza paving (plaza-paving-vr): scene_c1 f: red brick herringbone forecourt between the library steps and the pond plaza, grey border band; outline traced on the NGII 2025 sheet (the brick reads red in the sun, brown under the trees)
paving: VR plaza paving (plaza-paving-vr): scene_e1 f: light grey slab forecourt south of the central plaza with dark dots; outline traced on the NGII 2025 sheet

paving: VR plaza paving (plaza-paving-vr): scene_a9 d/b, scene_a10 d/l: A9 tree plaza, blue-grey 0.4 m pavers with terracotta squares on a 1.2 m grid; outline traced on the NGII 2025 sheet (brick wall RS0007W on its west edge)

paving: VR plaza paving (plaza-paving-vr): scene_d4 f/d: D4 entrance plaza, white speckled pavers with dark grey stripes along the plaza from the road to the steps; outline traced on the NGII 2025 sheet
paving: VR plaza paving (plaza-paving-vr): scene_e7 f/d: E7 front plaza, near-white pavers with scattered dark grey, blue and terracotta squares; outline traced on the NGII 2025 sheet
paving: VR plaza paving (plaza-paving-vr): scene_f1 f: F1 forecourt, large light grey slabs around a leaf-shaped lawn island; outline traced on the NGII 2025 sheet

paving: VR plaza paving (plaza-paving-vr): scene_b7 l/d: pink-red paver walk west of the B7 access drive; traced on the NGII 2025 sheet; R2 photo registration: ring redrawn on the pink walk of the NGII 2025 sheet (red-minus-green cross-sections: walk 1.6-1.7 m wide, 1.3 m east of the earlier ring, which covered the hedge west of it); follow-up: moved -0.125 m E / +0.125 m N, the half-pixel bias of the first photo sampling (pixel centres as the world file gives them)

paving: VR plaza paving (plaza-paving-vr): scene_a1 l: pink-red paver walk along the north edge of the fountain pond (RS-LS-A1POND), 1.6-3.6 m off its coping; the strip read on the NGII 2025 sheet; R2 photo registration: ring redrawn on the pink band of the NGII 2025 sheet (red-minus-green cross-sections every 1.5 m: band 1.1 m wide, E 243973.8-243990.2; the earlier ring lay 1.2 m south of it over the lawn and ran 3 m past its east end); follow-up: moved -0.125 m E / +0.125 m N, the half-pixel bias of the first photo sampling (pixel centres as the world file gives them)

paving: VR plaza paving (plaza-paving-vr): scene_a1 l: L-shaped grey plaza north of the fountain pond walk, light grey pavers with dark squares around a lawn bed; outline traced on the NGII 2025 sheet
